commits.message:
fix(docs): read fences with markdown-it, and refuse an example whose card would cut it out of its list, quote or code group (rich-docs-examples-xuu.77u)

scanBlocks now asks markdown-it (plus a catch-all ::: container) where each
fence is and what it sits in; the line scanner could not see a fence indented
four spaces into a list item. scriptLine reads the same blocks instead of
scanning fences a second time.

test(docs): gate every docs example — no hand-drawn output off NOT_YET_MIGRATED, no stale entries on it (rich-docs-examples-xuu.wlm) (#176)

* test(docs): gate every docs example — no hand-drawn output off NOT_YET_MIGRATED, no stale entries on it (rich-docs-examples-xuu.wlm)

scanBlocks is now the one fence parser; scanFences is the TypeScript view of it.
A fence Shiki draws as bare text or ansi is drawn output: decided by the fence,
not its contents. test/docs/example-gate.ts owns why.

* fix(docs): the example gate resolves a fence's language as VitePress does, and parses a page once (rich-docs-examples-xuu.wlm)

* fix(docs): the example gate asks VitePress's own shiki for its grammars (rich-docs-examples-xuu.wlm)
